from torch.distributed.device_mesh import init_device_mesh
from torch.distributed._tensor import DTensor

    ColwiseParallel,
    RowwiseParallel,
    parallelize_module,
)

_store_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
dist.init_process_group(
    "gloo",
    init_method="file://" + os.path.join(_store_dir, "store"),
    world_size=1,
    rank=0,
)


class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        torch.manual_seed(0)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(4, 8)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(8, 4)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.fc2(torch.relu(self.fc1(x)))


def parallelized_weight_placements():
    mesh = init_device_mesh("cpu", (1,))
    mlp = MLP()
    plan =
right_context:
parallelize_module(mlp, mesh, plan)
    return mlp.fc1.weight, mlp.fc2.weight
assertions:
weight1, weight2 = parallelized_weight_placements()
assert isinstance(weight1, DTensor)
assert isinstance(weight2, DTensor)
assert repr(weight1.placements[0]) == "Shard(dim=0)"
assert repr(weight2.placements[0]) == "Shard(dim=1)"
torch.manual_seed(0)
reference = MLP()
assert torch.equal(weight1.full_tensor(), reference.fc1.weight.detach())
assert torch.equal(weight2.full_tensor(), reference.fc2.weight.detach())
